summary: Trekor Metals Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its June 24, 2026 annual general meeting. The meeting passed routine items: election of nine directors by acclamation, appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor, fixing board size, a name change to Trekor Metals Limited, amendments to deferred share unit and stock option plans, and an advisory say-on-pay vote. No special-situation event (merger, tender offer, strategic review, activist campaign, or other corporate action) occurred. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update of an ordinary shareholder meeting, with no event triggering special-situations classification.
